name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-video-volc
description: Volcengine Ark (Seedance 2.0) video-generation provider for the DeepSeek Harness video seam (ctx.video) — submits chat-completions-style video tasks with reference-image messages over Bearer ARK API-key auth, polls the task endpoint until settlement, downloads the settled video URL into raw bytes, optionally registers public reference images as private-asset entries through the signed Volcengine OpenAPI control plane (HMAC-SHA256 AK/SK), reads every credential from named environment variables at call time, and surfaces endpoint failures as typed VIDEO_PROVIDER_FAILED errors with no local fallback
